# GroupDocs.Redaction for Java examples

Runnable examples: https://github.com/groupdocs-redaction/GroupDocs.Redaction-for-Java

Package: com.groupdocs:groupdocs-redaction
Maven repository: https://releases.groupdocs.com/java/repo/
Docs: https://docs.groupdocs.com/redaction/java/
API reference: https://reference.groupdocs.com/redaction/java/

From Examples/:

- mvn clean install
- mvn compile exec:java

JDK 8 or later. README recommends 17 LTS.
A license is required for a full run: https://purchase.groupdocs.com/temp-license/100510

Open Redactor, apply, save, close. Do not use a LATEST version pin.
